input_identity.note: 沿已交付十二分钟材料身份；只读小描述文件和文件stat，不重扫巨大Parquet/不签发新准入

candidate_state_before_release.note: 只保留已验证Reference物理位置/类型；路径与原reader、Parquet元数据/读批次另列，不包含完整TWAP历史

baseline-dependencies.digest_coverage: input stream/position/dependency refs and source id/source/received times; group id/position/member/close coordinates; fact position/source refs/direct and dependency time/quality; excludes full payload, source bodies and observation business fields

driver.boundary: returned-object explicit drop is separate from summary; candidate state release includes index/frontier decoder and paths; replay.into_core includes main reader release and move; final core drop separate; report serialization/write and diagnostic-state finalization excluded from driver wall, included in outer GNU process

effective_config.purpose: #214保存依赖和临时候选共用验证前沿；同最终binary、新候选，旧/共用依赖串行各一次；仅既有十二分钟，禁止prepare/小时/新数据/账户

retention.scan_by_input: all actually scanning Input positions with per-kind counts/rows/time; no per-row payload
retention.scan_descriptors: first 128 actual scan/open/page invocations; total by kind and omitted count retained
retention.slow_entries: 16 slowest whole entry calls; total and omitted count retained

time_accounting.candidate_evidence: all successful pages retain complete canonical fact/anchor/ref and cursor/cutoff; projection time is inside prepare_remaining, not independent production latency; progress emission cost is inside its caller and separately reported, never added again
time_accounting.decode_cost: metadata/row-group/successful batch spans are contained in candidate page or validation/open calls, not additional primary time; batch includes Arrow decode and SortRow materialization plus test size accounting; failed loads/batches stay in enclosing original-error spans
time_accounting.dependency_evidence: nonempty saved-ref requests retain all complete returned Reference events, including empty result; projection time is inside dependencies; validation/locating scan spans are nested there, not additive primary time
time_accounting.nested: candidate_open/candidate_page are contained in prepare and must not be added to primary; scan elapsed is a subset, not extra primary time
time_accounting.overhead: clock checks and local counting are inside this test diagnosis; bookkeeping at scope destruction falls within enclosing span or residual; overhead not independently isolated
time_accounting.residual: signed entry total minus non-overlapping primary spans; no zero clamp
time_accounting.size_accounting: Parquet memory_size is its estimated allocation including shared-pointer double counts, not RSS; Arrow and SortRow maximum refer to one successful batch, not process or all-reader sum
time_accounting.twap_encountered: original candidate_page counts decoded TWAP before filtering; indexed candidate_index_validation counts validated TWAP and indexed candidate_page counts selected body rows only; cached index visits have no full body decode

gnu.note: GNU文件系统字段保留原计数，不标作字节；进程I/O字节按driver原proc差值另列

driver_proc_io.note: driver起止采样含其间全部读取/预读/解码及进度输出；排除其后结果序列化写出，非候选某函数独占I/O

comparison.comparison_note: 完整候选页和全部非空依赖请求的完整Reference返回逐字段相等；真实观察仅有限身份/时钟/质量摘要，小夹具另比较完整值；一级/嵌套和全部位置扫描字段闭合

verification.native_reuse_note: 本任务树native all-targets及11个public_input_tests通过；最后仅收窄测试guard作用域，不改变公开接口或实际读/应用行为，复用这些消费验证
verification.clippy_note: 默认clippy退出0且存在既有警告，不声称零警告；未更改范围外警告

cache.note: 共享缓存时点观察变化，不保证他方增减可归因本任务；本轮未清理旧缓存，实测期间不构建，两次间缓存文件/字节未变。含首次实现验证、计时作用域修正后的最终回归及release构建。

projection_note.retained: 全部一级/嵌套/扫描合计及每实际Input计量、33页边界/数量、完整保存依赖返回及请求/来源/质量/时刻、计数、driver/resource、实际源码/锁/binary身份
omitted_fields: internal.candidate_pages中全部canonical_fact/anchor/record_ref正文和重复context；完整页已在私有原结果逐字段比较，公开保留全部页边界
internal.scans前128明细、slowest_entries前16和last_entry；保留全部scan_totals/scan_by_input及原保留/省略计数
driver.proc_io_before/after原字符串改为全部字段前后及差值
execution命令绝对路径、本机PID；effective_config.public_root和input_identity.public_root改为逻辑路径
build原binary路径/保留路径；不包含本机绑定与原stderr

limits: 一次串行pair，旧依赖在前新依赖在后，主机非隔离且允许其他工作，系统缓存顺序未控制；不能称稳定加速比例或外推小时/研究吞吐
首次非空依赖校验完整原稳定视图至EOF；此约19秒责任未被消除。消除的是与候选前沿重叠校验，并新增依赖正文定位成本
原验证记录/JSON解析行、定位Arrow解码行和目标JSON解析行分列，不混单位合计成总解码
完整33页候选/1条真实依赖返回逐字段相等，真实观察仍只有限身份/时钟/质量摘要；完整观察由代表小夹具验证，不冒充真实806966观察全字段序列化
40B索引len/cap随本次完整Reference数增长；本次容量仍655360B不是所有研究范围上界。Parquet memory_size含共享指针重复估计，不是RSS；64MiB仍仅原SortRow批次预算
保存依赖外部独立入口/历史身份/在线候选沿原路径；不改core、writer、生产进度、准备/回测装配、B分支或C业务；小时/三日/15日存储和跨阶段重复重建仍未闭合
